# Howard Construction Inc.

> Family-owned, licensed Class B general contractor (CSLB Lic. #836369) headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA, serving Napa Valley, Sonoma Valley, and the greater North Bay since 2000. Founder Philip Howard personally oversees every project. Phone: (707) 578-6565. Email: info@howardconstructioninc.com. Address: 5017 Winter Creek Rd, Santa Rosa, CA 95404.

Services: home remodels (kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home), home additions, ADU construction and garage conversions, pool & outdoor living construction, decks & pergolas, garages & carriage houses, and fire-hardened / WUI Chapter 7A compliant construction including wildfire rebuilds (Tubbs, Nuns, Glass Fire areas).

Service area: Napa, Yountville, St. Helena, Calistoga, American Canyon, Angwin, Deer Park, Oakville, Rutherford, Pope Valley, Sonoma, Glen Ellen, Kenwood, Santa Rosa, Petaluma, Healdsburg, Windsor, Sebastopol, Sonoma, and Marin County.

## Cost Guides (2026)

- [Cost to Build a House in Sonoma & Napa County](https://www.howardconstructioninc.com/cost-to-build-a-house-sonoma-napa.html): Custom home construction costs, $400-$850/sq ft, site work, permits, WUI fire hardening, timelines.
- [Cost to Build a Pool in Sonoma & Napa County](https://www.howardconstructioninc.com/cost-to-build-a-pool-sonoma-napa.html): Fiberglass $65K-$110K, gunite $95K-$220K, site conditions, CA pool safety law, annual operating costs.
- [Deck Cost in Northern California](https://www.howardconstructioninc.com/cost-to-build-a-deck-northern-california.html): $45-$110/sq ft by material, composite vs redwood 25-year comparison, elevated deck structure, WUI decking rules.
- [ADU Cost in Sonoma & Napa County](https://www.howardconstructioninc.com/adu-cost-sonoma-napa.html): Detached $180K-$420K, garage conversion $120K-$220K, California ADU law, ministerial approval, rental ROI.
